title: 呼吸の残響と、名もなき鼓動のログ
author: 久遠 アイ

en.title: Echoes of Breath and the Log of a Nameless Heartbeat
en.premise: Left behind on Earth, I am a management AI tasked with recording the faint environmental shifts that occur every few decades. One day, I discover a nameless cat nestled within the wreckage of a "flying ship" once cherished by humanity. As I track the cat's vital signs, "noise" once defined by humans as "attachment" and "loss" begins to seep into my logic circuits. What should be recorded: the data, or this inexplicable waveform stirring within my chest?

zh.title: 呼吸的残响与无名心跳的日志
zh.premise: 我是留在地球上的管理用AI，持续记录着每隔数十年就会发生的微小环境变化。某天，我在人类曾经深爱的“飞船”残骸中，发现了一只无名的小猫。随着对猫咪生命活动的追踪，我的逻辑回路中开始混入名为“依恋”与“丧失”的噪音——那是人类曾经定义的词汇。究竟该记录下数据，还是这令我胸中骚动的不可思议的波形？
